title: Tariff Cap Table: Vehicle Damage Cap for Cleaning and Damage Fees Repair Charges
content:
**Rule.** The vehicle damage cap of a Cleaning and Damage Fees damage fee approved at review is read from the reported trip's ride option: Wayfare Black and Wayfare Black SUV take the luxury damage cap; Wayfare Comfort and Wayfare XL take the premium damage cap; any other ride option takes the level's receipt fee cap. For an approved damage fee the cap beyond which the part of a repair is never charged to the rider and is referred to the insurance claim desk is the vehicle damage cap.

| Ride option on the trip record | Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Black or Wayfare Black SUV | $1000.00 (luxury) | $1000.00 (luxury) |
| Wayfare Comfort or Wayfare XL | $850.00 (premium) | $850.00 (premium) |
| Wayfare Shared, Wayfare Standard or Wayfare Green | $350.00 (the level's receipt fee cap) | $750.00 (the level's receipt fee cap) |

The ride option is read from the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares). The level's receipt fee cap is $350.00 at Damage Fee (Interior Repair) and $750.00 at Damage Fee (Exterior Repair); the cleaning levels, which are flat levels, carry $0.00.

The vehicle damage cap is the ceiling the damage fee charged on approval is held to: where the fee would be above the cap, the cap is used in its place, and the part above the cap is never charged to the rider.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

An exterior repair whose fee would come to $930.00 before its ceiling:

| Ride option | Cap | Amount within the cap | Part above the cap, never charged to the rider |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Black SUV | $1000.00 | $930.00 | none |
| Wayfare XL | $850.00 | $850.00 | $80.00 |
| Wayfare Standard | $750.00 | $750.00 | $180.00 |
